proposals.name: Call for Proposals: Climate Change AI Innovation Grants 2024
proposals.keywords: artificial intelligence, machine learning, data science
proposals.match_reason: The grant provides funding for research and deployment projects utilizing AI and machine learning to address climate change mitigation, adaptation, and climate science.
proposals.eligibility_notes: The Principal Investigator must be affiliated with an accredited university in one of the 38 OECD Member Countries. Co-Investigators can be from any country or institution.
